Name: Realistic - Cornucopia
Author: wwwfruity
Description:
Are you tired of Cornucopia's mods not matching with the visual of your game? Do you want a more realistic style? This mod is your solution!

Realistic Cornucopia is a complete retexture of Cornucopia's mods, made to match a more realistic style.

[size=4]CHANGES (everything is configurable with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url])[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Artisan Goods[/size]
[*][size=3]Crops[/size]
[*][size=3]Flowers[/size]
[*]Fruit Trees and Flowers
[*][size=3]Giant Crops[/size]
[*]Herbs
[*][size=3]Seeds, Starters, Saplings and Planters[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]TO-DO LIST[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Cornucopia - Artisan Machine's Artisan Goods[/size]
[/list][size=3]
REMINDER: This mod is completely made with free resources and pictures from internet. I used Photopea to make, edit and resize all sprites.
[/size]
